findings.title: OptimizedCursorPaginator fails with TypeError when ordering by a DateTimeField
findings.body: `OrganizationAuditLogsEndpoint.get` configures `OptimizedCursorPaginator` with `order_by="-datetime"`, where `AuditLogEntry.datetime` is a `DateTimeField`. Unlike `DateTimePaginator`, `OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_item_key` passes `getattr(item, self.key)` directly to `math.floor` / `math.ceil`, which raises `TypeError: must be real number, not datetime.datetime` whenever results are present. In addition, `OptimizedCursorPaginator.value_from_cursor` returns the raw numeric cursor value rather than converting it to a `datetime` object, causing `build_queryset` to compare a timestamp column against a number in SQL.

findings.title: Negative cursor offsets cause unhandled ValueError in Django QuerySet slicing
findings.body: In `OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_result` (lines 877-886) and `BasePaginator.get_result` (lines 182-184), negative `cursor.offset` values are passed directly as `start_offset` into `queryset[start_offset:stop]` (when `enable_advanced_features` is True with `cursor.offset < 0`, or whenever `cursor.is_prev` is True and `offset < 0`). Django's `QuerySet.__getitem__` explicitly rejects negative slice bounds with `ValueError("Negative indexing is not supported.")`. Because `Endpoint.paginate` only catches `BadPaginationError` around `paginator.get_result`, supplying a negative offset in a cursor produces an unhandled 500 Internal Server Error instead of a 400 response.

findings.title: Unchecked organization_context.member access raises AttributeError for non-member requests
findings.body: `organization_context.member.has_global_access` is evaluated on every `GET` request whenever `request.user.is_superuser` is `False`, even when `optimized_pagination` is not enabled. When this endpoint is called using an organization token, API key, or Sentry App installation (where `request.user.is_superuser` is `False` and `organization_context.member` is `None`), dereferencing `organization_context.member.has_global_access` raises `AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'has_global_access'`.
